label: No. 3 Covered Slip (1838), ground floor, Chatham Historic Dockyard
note: covered shipbuilding slip; receivers DPA and ST; the 63 Hz and 8 kHz T30 (6-9 s) measure noise plateaus that the files' fade-out then lowers; the 8 kHz decay itself is about 0.9-1.1 s (EDT). At 1 kHz the decay slows between -34 and -45 dB before the fade, so T30 (and rt_mid) runs about 10 % above T20 and EDT in the DPA and ST450 binaural files (3.56 s against 3.1-3.3 s at 1 kHz).

note: DPA and KM184 pairs; the KM184 files named Cellar (MixPre take 031, 11:33) and Billiard Room (take 029, 11:25) are read the other way round.
